note: Every single-view unit of the round-9 runtime (a name reported by one view, source 'view', on a slot that never holds it; scripts/views/vounits.py; unit = slot + name, keyframes within 8 s) in all four sessions, checked by eye on full-resolution zooms with the box, its crop and the zoom where a slot holds the same name (vt.py), and full-rate strips around the keyframe where unsure (strip.py). right = the card's identity is legible there or the same physical card is followed to where it is named; unverifiable = pips or index hidden (fingers, a fan, motion) and not followed; wrong = legible as another card. stillReported = the round-10 runtime still reports it. staleUnits = round 9's 18 stale hidden units (left = still reported for some keyframes). hiddenRemovedSample = 24 random units of the 885 hidden-report units round 10 removes beyond those: stale = the card was being collected or picked up, stays = the card still lies there under a passing hand or arm (a right report lost).
